lines.zh: 四蹄踩过枯枝，一路脆响
lines.en: Four hooves crack the dead branches all the way.

lines.zh: 鬃毛扫着夜色，我往前走
lines.en: My mane sweeps the night as I walk on.

lines.zh: 我这身骨头，走路带点响
lines.en: These bones of mine rattle a little as I go.

lines.zh: 没人给我上鞍，我也照样跑
lines.en: No saddle on me, and I still run.

lines.zh: 沿着林子边缘走，避开灯火
lines.en: I keep to the treeline and shun the torchlight.

lines.zh: 蹄印留在泥里，很快就被草盖住
lines.en: My prints sink in the mud and the grass hides them.
Each step dips my head to sniff the old trail.

lines.zh: 雾里走，看不清也走不偏
lines.en: I walk through fog, blind but never astray.

lines.zh: 骨头轻了，走起来倒轻快
lines.en: My bones are light, and so is my stride.
I don't graze, I only walk.

lines.zh: 白天躲着，夜里才放开腿
lines.en: By day I hide; at night I let my legs out.

lines.zh: 走远些，这地方不属于我
lines.en: Farther off, this place isn't mine.
I stand still and my tail doesn't even swish.
Wind passes my ribs like blowing through an empty can.
I don't eat grass and I don't drink.

lines.zh: 眼皮垂着，其实听着四周
lines.en: My lids droop, but I'm listening all around.
I bury my face in the dark.
Standing this long costs me nothing.

lines.zh: 有虫子爬过腿骨，我不在意
lines.en: A bug crawls my leg bone and I ignore it.

lines.zh: 呼吸是没有的，但我还站着
lines.en: I have no breath, yet here I stand.

lines.zh: 安静的夜里，我像块石头
lines.en: On a quiet night I look like a stone.
I wait for the wind to stop before I move.

lines.zh: 你盯着我，我倒想看看你
lines.en: You stare at me, so let me look back.

lines.zh: 人类，你身上有活人的热气
lines.en: Human, you carry the warmth of the living.

lines.zh: 别摸我的鬃毛，那不干净
lines.en: Don't touch my mane, it isn't clean.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛没有光，你还敢看
lines.en: My eyes have no light, and you still dare look.

lines.zh: 你是来找马骑的，还是来找我的
lines.en: Did you come for a mount, or for me?
A living horse wouldn't look at you like this.
You took a step back, I saw it.
The saddle's gone and the reins have rotted.

lines.zh: 你手里有苹果，闻着像笑话
lines.en: You hold an apple, and it smells like a joke.
Don't talk to me, I don't answer.

lines.zh: 骨头裂了一丝，听着刺耳
lines.en: A bone cracks and the sound grates.
That blow knocked my frame loose.
I back off with my hooves trembling.
Pain is a strange thing to me.
Don't knock on my ribs.

lines.zh: 没血肉可掉，你还是伤到我了
lines.en: Nothing fleshy to spill, and you still hurt me.
My hoof stumbled.

lines.zh: 这具身体也会疼，你没想到吧
lines.en: This body feels pain too, bet you didn't think so.
I shake my head and bits fall off.
A few more and I'll come apart.
I can't eat apples, keep them.

lines.zh: 你举着草料，我只觉得可笑
lines.en: You raise the hay, and it's just funny to me.
The sweetness is distant and cold to my nose.

lines.zh: 活人的食物给死人马，荒唐
lines.en: Living food for a dead horse, absurd.
If you truly want to feed me, lay your life down.

lines.zh: 我闻见马槽的味，是旧记忆
lines.en: I smell an old trough, and it's just a memory.
An apple won't buy me.
Stop waving that carrot.
I'm not hungry, and even hungry I couldn't eat.
The scent stirs no appetite in me.
You bumped my ribs; that must sting.
My hooves don't dodge people, so you move.
You brushed me and the chill made you shiver.

lines.zh: 这具身子重，撞一下不清
lines.en: This body is heavy; a bump leaves a mark.
Don't stand at a horse's flank.
You touched me, step away.
Bone knocks bone with a dull sound.

lines.zh: 马蹄落地的震，你感觉得到
lines.en: You can feel the thump of my hooves landing.
Don't push, you can't move me.
Make way, I'm coming through.

lines.zh: 这身子还能有同类，倒也奇怪
lines.en: Strange that this body still has kin.

lines.zh: 两匹死马对望，谁都不出声
lines.en: Two dead horses face each other in silence.
Hoof taps hoof, and that's a greeting.

lines.zh: 夜里林子深处，还有另一串蹄印
lines.en: Deeper in the woods there's another set of prints.

lines.zh: 我们不生小马，只把影子并在一起
lines.en: We won't make foals, we just stand our shadows side by side.

lines.zh: 同类的味道，是土和旧铁的味
lines.en: My kind smells of soil and old iron.
It knows what I'm waiting for.

lines.zh: 别打扰我们，这也是马的事
lines.en: Don't intrude, this is horse business too.

lines.zh: 鬃毛碰在一起，风穿过两副骨头
lines.en: Manes meet, and wind passes through two sets of bones.
At dawn we go back to our own woods.
I can't pick up that iron, my mouth is clumsy.

lines.zh: 地上掉的东西，我不弯脖子
lines.en: Things on the ground, I won't bend my neck for.

lines.zh: 马蹄踩碎它，比捡起来好
lines.en: Better to crush it underhoof than pick it up.
That's mine, leave it.
There's nowhere in these bones to put it.
I sniffed it once and walked away.

lines.zh: 给马的东西，得是能扛的
lines.en: Things for a horse should be things it can carry.
A fallen saddle, and it fits.
I kicked it and it rolled away.
The ground is mine, but I can't be bothered.
Living, finally something living.

lines.zh: 那边有人在走，蹄子就痒
lines.en: Someone walks over there, and my hooves itch.

lines.zh: 我看见热气从你身上冒出来
lines.en: I see the heat rising off you.

lines.zh: 林子里有脚步声，不是我的
lines.en: Footsteps in the woods, and they aren't mine.
A horse doesn't need a reason to charge.
You turn to run, perfect.

lines.zh: 那个方向，风把味道送过来
lines.en: That way, the wind brings the scent.
Hitting from the side costs the least.
The grass stills; it's standing there.

lines.zh: 铁的味道，从它身上来的
lines.en: Iron smell, and it comes from that one.

lines.zh: 我踢过太多次，认得距离
lines.en: I've kicked enough times to know the range.
I fix my eyes, and it can't get away.
Front legs lift, that's the one.
I lower my head and get ready to charge.
That one, and I won't wait longer.
Ten paces more and my hooves come up.
No hurry, a dead horse waits best.
It runs, and I run after.
I choose the moment its back is turned.
Loading my hoof to kick it over at once.
It looks back, so I stand still.
You circle the tree, so I circle after you.

lines.zh: 肋骨里在响，那是要冲了
lines.en: My ribs rattle, which means I'm about to charge.
Still quite far, which suits me.
It stepped in mud and lost half a beat.
I can't get through here, so I go around back.
The prints go left, so I cut left.

lines.zh: 你听，蹄声停了，那更可怕
lines.en: Listen, the hoofbeats stopped, and that's worse.
The trees block its retreat, and it panics.
I creep in slow and wear down its nerve.
The last few steps, and even the wind stops.
It raises a shield, so I aim for the legs.
One more look, that's all the distance left.
Front hooves rear up and come down.
My hind legs kick and it flies.
Hooves hit the chest with a dull thud.
I swing my head and knock it aside.
I pin its shield underhoof and press down.
A spinning kick lands on the flank.
The shoe's still on, good for this.
One kick isn't enough, so here's another.
I slam into it and it's three steps back.
I kick the knee and make it kneel.
Bone against bone, which holds?
I kick up dust while it can't see.
Two hind kicks in a row, no gap.
It's on the ground, and I look down at it.

lines.zh: 这一蹄带着旧铁的味道
lines.en: This hoof carries the smell of old iron.

lines.zh: 它抓住了我的鬃毛，没用
lines.en: It grabbed my mane; useless.

lines.zh: 雾散开，我就在这儿站着
lines.en: The fog parts and here I stand.
Someone turned the soil, so I woke.

lines.zh: 缰绳早断了，我却还记得路
lines.en: The reins broke long ago, but I remember the road.

lines.zh: 马蹄第一次踏在这片草地上
lines.en: My hooves touch this grass for the first time.
The night wind carries an old stable smell.

lines.zh: 从林子里走出来，眼睛没有光
lines.en: I walk out of the woods with lightless eyes.
That skeleton stands up.

lines.zh: 这片林子的草要枯了吧
lines.en: The grass here will wither now, I think.

lines.zh: 我不记得谁把我埋在这里
lines.en: I don't remember who buried me here.

lines.zh: 圈子绕了三遍，才算站稳
lines.en: Three turns of the circle before I settle.
The first clack of my iron hoof.

lines.zh: 我踏进夜色，缰绳还在晃
lines.en: I step into the night, the reins still swinging.
The woods have gone quiet.
I'm back, and no one greets me.

lines.zh: 火里我闻见自己烧焦的味
lines.en: In the fire I smell myself burning.

lines.zh: 摔下去，一条腿不听话了
lines.en: I landed and one leg won't obey.
Water fills my frame and I sink.

lines.zh: 炸得我滚了半圈，蹄子朝天
lines.en: The blast rolls me half a turn, hooves in the air.
The arrow wedges between my ribs.
Spell light burns through the bone.

lines.zh: 饿是不饿，可这副架子在垮
lines.en: I don't hunger, yet this frame is giving out.
Lightning runs through my bones and numbs all of me.
The emptiness of the void pulls me down.
